title: Isengard Mechanics
text: <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> Discard an <symbol>isengard</symbol> Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion (or 2 companions if you spot 6 companions). <keyword>Regroup:</keyword> If this minion is stacked on an <symbol>isengard</symbol> card, spot an <symbol>isengard</symbol> Orc and discard this minion to add <symbol>twilight3</symbol>.
